description: How spell levels change when magnitudes are added or removed.

records.name: Magnitude scaling
records.summary: Each step of Range, Duration, or Target adds one magnitude. At level 5 and above a magnitude is five levels; below level 5 a magnitude is one level.

algorithm.note: Apply magnitudes one at a time, re-checking the threshold after each step. A level 15 spell reduced by five magnitudes is level 2, not level -10: the first two magnitudes take it 15 → 10 → 5, and the remaining three take it 5 → 4 → 3 → 2.

examples.note: Voice→Sight and Sun→Moon on a level 15 spell.
